set_total_pulses.docs: Using this action, you are able to reset/set the total pulse count. This can be useful if you would like the `total` sensor to match what you see on your meter you are trying to match.

internal_filter.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: If a pulse shorter than this time is detected, it is discarded. Defaults to `13us`. This acts as a debounce filter to eliminate input noise, so choose a value a little less than your expected minimum pulse width.

*See also: [Pulse Meter Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pulse_meter#configuration-variables)*

internal_filter_mode.docs:
**string**: Determines how the internal filter is applied. One of `EDGE` or `PULSE`. Defaults to `EDGE`.

*See also: [Pulse Meter Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pulse_meter#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The pin to count pulses on.

*See also: [Pulse Meter Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pulse_meter#configuration-variables)*

timeout.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: If we don't see a pulse for this length of time, we assume *0 pulses/s*. Defaults to `5 min`.

*See also: [Pulse Meter Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pulse_meter#configuration-variables)*

total.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: An additional sensor that outputs the total number of pulses counted.

*See also: [Pulse Meter Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pulse_meter#configuration-variables)*
